changelog: feat: the beta console starts real jobs. It posts to the same POST /upload and POST /run/{job_id} the production console uses, against the same job store, so a job started at /beta is indistinguishable from one started at / and appears in both. Adds: real file upload with drag-and-drop, client-side metadata CSV parsing into MetaRow, cancel, and the truncLen/low_merge checkpoint decision — which now shows the keep-rates and the measured suggestion instead of only saying a run is paused, because those numbers ARE the decision. The point of the pre-run checks is to make a run refusable before it costs fifteen minutes of CPU: pairing is resolved from the filenames and displayed BEFORE upload, sample-by-sample with the exact file each side resolved to, metadata is matched by name, and Start stays disabled with the reason written next to it. The anchored _R1/_R2 token rule from 2.8.3 is ported verbatim and regression-tested on the U2BI-139 filenames (Pre-R1_1.fq.gz — the sample is called R1, the token is the trailing _1) which broke sample detection twice. Settings: the eight pipeline steps are now separate cards with numbered headings instead of hairline-separated rows, every field is editable and posted under its real RunParams key, and the taxonomy database can be chosen from the Taxonomy step as well as from Essential — the two controls are kept in lockstep so they cannot disagree. A preflight check with nothing to check now shows grey rather than a green tick. Verified by driving Chromium against a stub reproducing the real endpoints: 116 checks, including that every key posted is a real RunParams field (pydantic drops unknown keys silently, so an invented one would run with a default nobody chose).
